zh-TW.title: 字母記憶更新（Letter Memory）
zh-TW.description: 字母一個一個出現，長度不一定；一直記住最新的 4 個，結束後依序輸入，練習隨時更新記住的內容。

en.title: Letter Memory
en.description: Letters appear one at a time, and you cannot tell when the sequence ends. Keep the latest four in mind and type them at the end. Practice updating what you hold in mind.
